card.name: Words introducing a risk or hazard
card.fires_on: Words in warning text just before a risk is named, such as the end of 'medication errors', 'transmission of', or 'may' before an interference or harm statement.

modes.label: Medication error and transmission wording
modes.description: The end of 'medication errors' or the word 'of' after 'transmission', before infectious agents or routes of error.
modes.example: TO REDUCE THE POTENTIAL FOR FATAL MEDICATION ERR<<ORS>> DUE TO INCORRECT ROUTE

modes.label: Verb or helper word before an effect
modes.description: 'may' or 'had' right after a substance or patient group, leading into an interference or risk statement.
modes.example: Mineral oil<< may>> weaken latex or rubber products such as condoms

modes.label: Heading words in safety sections
modes.description: A noun inside a section heading about risk, access or registries.
modes.example: Pregnancy: Pregnancy Exposure<< Registry>> There is a pregnancy registry that monitors pregnancy
